summary.text: Adrianne Ramos is a Democratic state representative from the 14th Essex District who has held the seat since January 4, 2023 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026. She is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Adrianne Ramos earned a B.S. in international affairs from the University of Maine in 2001 and a J.D. from New England Law | Boston in 2007.

Her career experience includes working as a partner with Prince Lobel Tye LLP and Fayez & Ramos, PLLC, as an attorney with the Law Office of Adrianne P Ramos, PLLC, and as a family law attorney with the Tahirih Justice Center.
She succeeded Christina Minicucci in the 14th Essex District seat in 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session she is vice chair of the Housing Joint Committee and also serves on the House Post Audit and Oversight Committee and the Judiciary and Labor and Workforce Development joint committees.
